text: dsh-file-upload 是 DSH Web 的文件消息插件，提供回形针选择、多文件拖放与粘贴上传，并在输入框中插入可引用的相对路径。它通过会话工作区保存附件，由 read_document 按页读取并将常见文档转换为 Markdown；图片可走原生读图或视觉端点生成说明。适合需要把文档、表格或图片交给 DSH 分析的用户。安装后可直接使用，视觉说明的外部服务配置为可选。

dsh-file-upload adds paperclip, drag-and-drop, and paste uploads to DSH Web. It inserts relative-path references and provides read_document for paged Markdown conversion. Images use native reading or an optional vision endpoint for descriptions. Use it to work with local files in web chats.
想把几份本地文档拖进 DSH 对话里让它帮我分析。
DSH 能不能在输入框旁边加个按钮选择附件？
我希望上传的 PDF 和 Word 文档能转成模型容易读取的文本。
让 DSH 逐页读取长文档，别一次塞满上下文。
有没有办法用 @ 路径引用刚上传的文件？
我想粘贴图片或文件到输入框时自动作为附件上传。
How can I attach several files to a web chat by dragging them in?
I need a tool that reads PDFs and spreadsheets as paged Markdown.
Can images be described automatically for a text-only model?
I want uploaded files to appear as relative-path references in my prompt.
dsh-file-upload 的功能「回形针按钮」：选择器支持多文件；所选文件上传后在会话附件区显示状态卡片，并可取消或移除。
dsh-file-upload 的功能「拖放与粘贴」：在聊天窗口拖入文件或文件夹，或粘贴文件即可上传；附件会显示上传进度和结果。
dsh-file-upload 的功能「路径引用」：上传完成的文件可通过 @ 输入触发器按相对路径查找，并以引用形式插入输入框。
dsh-file-upload 的功能「文档转换」：read_document 根据内容识别文件类型，并将支持的文档转换为 Markdown 后返回。
dsh-file-upload 的功能「分页读取」：read_document 接收起始行和行数上限，返回带行号的片段及剩余页提示。
dsh-file-upload 的功能「转换缓存」：解析结果使用按条目数和字节预算约束的 LRU 缓存；文件版本变化后使用不同缓存键。
dsh-file-upload 的功能「图片说明」：根据会话图像能力选择原生读图或生成文字说明；说明路线可探测本地 Ollama 与兼容服务。
dsh-file-upload 使用前须知：图片说明若匹配到 DeepSeek 或 OpenAI 视觉端点，会将图片用于生成描述；视觉端点为可选配置。
dsh-file-upload 使用前须知：没有可用视觉端点时，图片仍可作为路径引用上传；文档读取由 read_document 按需执行。

dsh-file-upload README · Features：- **Upload** — composer paperclip button plus a global drag-and-drop overlay ("release to attach"), multi-file support.
- **Attachment cards** — color-coded type badges (PDF red / DOC blue / XLS green / TXT gray / ZIP purple / JSON gold) with name and size; removable.
- **Codex-style file references** — uploaded files appear in the message as `@relative/path` references (like OpenAI Codex), never as raw content dumped into the composer; the agent reads the file with `read_document` (converted to Markdown on demand).
- **Codex-style `@` mentions** — type `@` in the composer to pick any uploaded file by its relative path; the reference inserts as a mention.
- **Document → Markdown, fully bundled** — the MarkItDown engine ships inside the plugin (Microsoft MarkItDown TypeScript port, `markitdown-node`): PDF / DOCX / PPTX / XLSX / HTML / CSV / JSON / XML / RSS / Atom / ZIP / Jupyter / image OCR / audio transcription. **No Python, no downloads, no setup.**
- **Image explanation for text-only models** — upload an image and the plugin automatically generates a **description ("讲解图片")** through a vision discovery chain, so the DeepSeek API (text-only) can r

Codex-style `@relative/path` reference (the raw content and absolute host
paths never appear in the chat). Images additionally get **content support**
based on what your session's model can do, detected at upload time:
section: How images are handled (Codex-style reference + auto-explained)

text:
dsh-file-upload README · How images are handled (Codex-style reference + auto-explained)：| Detected route | What happens |
|---|---|
| **Multimodal model** (declares `image` input, e.g. GPT-4o / Qwen-VL / Claude / Gemini) | the `@reference` is inserted; the agent calls the `read_image` tool and the image enters model context directly |
| **A `read_image` tool is registered** (official tool or a vision bridge such as dsh-vision-toolkit) | detected automatically — same native path (the model fetches the image content itself) |
| **Text-only model** (the DeepSeek API is text-only) | if a description can be generated, the message carries `[图片: name] 图片讲解: <description>` right before the `@reference`, so the text-only model reasons about the image content immediately; if no vision endpoint is configured, only the clean `@reference` is inserted (the agent can still OCR via `read_document`) |
section: How images are handled (Codex-style reference + auto-explained)

text: dsh-file-upload README · How images are handled (Codex-style reference + auto-explained)：**Vision discovery chain** (zero-config, in order): ① explicit `visionEndpoint`/`visionModel` → ② **local Ollama** at `http://localhost:11434` (picks a VL model such as DeepSeek-VL2 — images never leave the machine) → ③ **DeepSeek official vision API** (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`, uses the `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` already configured in your DSH credentials — no extra setup) → ④ OpenAI standard endpoint using a key from the dsh credentials seam. Without any of these, images upload as plain references (no fallback text).
section: How images are handled (Codex-style reference + auto-explained)

text: dsh-file-upload README · How images are handled (Codex-style reference + auto-explained)：> **DeepSeek now has an official multimodal model**: [`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/vision/) accepts JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP via the standard OpenAI-compatible format. The plugin's vision chain picks it up automatically through your existing DeepSeek key, so uploading an image immediately produces a high-quality `[图片: name] 图片讲解: …` block for text-only models. You can also make DSH itself route images natively: add `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` as a custom model of the deepseek-official provider with `inputModalities: ["text", "image"]` (settings → Models, or the `llm-deepseek.models` settings section) and switch the session to it — the plugin then detects native image input and the agent reads images directly.
section: How images are handled (Codex-style reference + auto-explained)

text: dsh-file-upload README · How images are handled (Codex-style reference + auto-explained)：Route detection mirrors the official `read_image` gate (`ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo` + `inputModalities`), plus a live check for a registered `read_image` tool.

dsh-file-upload README · Architecture：```
src/
├── index.ts        # entry: apply + Config schema + assembly
├── detect.ts       # content sniffing (never trusts extensions)
├── convert.ts      # MarkItDown engine + optional CLI backend

Dual-face plugin: `dsh.bundle` (host) + `dsh.client` (web UI). No official patches — everything uses official seams (`ctx.webServer`, `ctx.tools`, `ctx.systemPrompt`, `ctx.sessions`, `slash/input-insert-text`, `slash/input-insert-reference`).

dsh-file-upload README · Security：- Uploads are loopback-only and same-origin checked.
- File names are sanitized (control chars, path separators, dot segments, leading dots stripped).
- Storage is session-isolated under the session's own workspace; unknown sessions get 403.
- sha256 content dedup, bounded concurrency (429 on overload), TTL sweep.
- Text extraction parses bytes, never trusts extensions; binaries are handed to the agent by path only.
